rounds.text: Tashi India Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.47x compared to a book value of ₹ 245 per share [E2]. This valuation is starkly disconnected from the broader sector, as the company maintains a P/E of 8.18x against a sector benchmark of 22.82x and a P/B of 0.48x against a sector benchmark of 1.56x [E5, E6]. The company demonstrates superior operational efficiency, delivering an ROA of 5.19% and an ROE of 3.92% in contrast to the negative sector benchmarks of -104.41% and -11.87% respectively [E7, E8]. Recent performance indicators highlight strong momentum, with sales growth of 121% year-over-year and profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E51, E54]. While the long-term compounded profit growth remains steady at 7%, the acceleration to 17% over five years and 61% over three years suggests an improving trajectory [E17, E18, E19]. Conceded: the dividend yield is 0.00% and compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months is -44% [E4, E20].
